annotations.title: Look up one security control, verbatim

description: What does this security control actually require? Give a control number and get that provision's text exactly as its publisher prints it, with the citation, the source URL and the publisher's own page. Covers NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 (e.g. "SC-28", "AC-2a", "AU-6(1)") and the HIPAA Security Rule, 45 CFR part 164 subpart C (e.g. "164.312(a)(2)(iv)"). One record is one obligation, so a control with lettered statements answers per statement, and the sub-provisions under the one you asked for are listed by citation. A control number we do not hold returns "not in our records" -- never a paraphrase and never a guess. SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS are deliberately absent: that text is copyrighted by the bodies that sell it.

framework.description: Optional. Assert which document you meant: "nist" for NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, "hipaa" for the HIPAA Security Rule. The two numbering schemes do not collide, so this is only needed to be told when a control number belongs to the other one.

id.description: The control number as the publisher cites it, e.g. "SC-28", "SC-28(1)", "AC-2a", "164.312(a)(2)(iv)". A leading "45 CFR", a section sign or "NIST SP 800-53" is ignored, and case does not matter.
